input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: Section 3.2 renews each Service Option Attachment automatically but requires 90 days' written notice to stop renewal, exceeding the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window. Renewal pricing is also uncapped: Section 13.1 permits IBM to change Service Option Attachment prices after 12 months on 90 days' notice with no percentage limit. We therefore target the fallback: the notice window is set to 60 days in plain figures, and any renewal-term charge is capped at 105% of the immediately preceding term (a 5% ceiling). Section 13.1's mid-term change right, non-retroactivity and Customer's 30-day no-charge termination election are left intact. Preferred wording (12-month renewal terms, 30-day opt-out, 60-day IBM reminder, lesser of CPI and 3%) is not met and is noted rather than redlined; if any Order Form term exceeds 12 months, we should escalate to fix the renewal term at twelve months.

proposal.summary: Non-renewal notice window set to 60 days and renewal charges capped at 105% of prior term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cut the non-renewal notice window to 60 days and capped any renewal uplift at 5% of the prior term's charges, consistent with our fallback renewal position.

ops.oldText: at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
ops.newText: at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term

ops.text: Charges for each renewal term will not exceed 105% of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term of the applicable Service Option Attachment.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
